title: TP-doctrine baseline grew 50->77 in 3 PRs on 10-27 although it 'may only shrink'; nothing detects a baseline edit
note: WEEKLY-AUDIT-2026-10-28 C2. MEASURED from git show of scripts/ci/check_tp_doctrine.py BASELINE_2026_10_06 per commit: 50 (38a752038, 10-24) -> 51 (#20481) -> 53 (#20551) -> 75 (#20561 DEMO-FLOOR RULE) -> 77 (#20668). All 3 were operator-approved Tier-3 roster PRs; each added its new non-compliant routings to the baseline in the same diff, so the guard's 'NEW non-compliant routing FAILS' rule never fired. Current: 0 of 77 routings compliant (real-money 0/6, prop 0/6, mirror 0/5, paper 0/60). Fix (Tier 1): a guard that fails when len(BASELINE) on the PR head > base ref unless the PR body/landing file carries an explicit tp_debt_added list (so growth is a visible decision, never a side effect). Detector = that guard + a self-test planting one added line. check: count BASELINE entries on main next week; rule: growth only with a tp_debt_added record.
